description:
A coastal route leads the child away from familiar neighbors into a petty theft and toward the working harbour. Wind-bent flowers, foraging creatures, a resting fire and the old storehouse keep the pursuit grounded in a place people use.

The route broadens into the inhabited pond to the south; its western concealed trail is a footpath, while the island obelisk remains a later Surf destination. The visible regional Psyduck is at that pond, not another roadside individual. Road grass farther north still offers rare regional Psyduck alongside Zigzagoon, Sunkern and Ekans.

name: The South Coast Road
